title: UCP failure: no capability in common
summary: The platform only supports carts and the business only supports checkout, so the intersection is empty. This is a business outcome, not a transport error: HTTP 200, ucp.status error, a capabilities_incompatible message and an optional continue_url to the web storefront.

steps.label: POST /carts with UCP-Agent
steps.detail: The platform profile lists only dev.ucp.shopping.cart.

steps.label: Intersection is empty
steps.detail: The business lists only dev.ucp.shopping.checkout, so no capability survives the first step of the algorithm.

steps.label: 200 OK, ucp.status error, capabilities_incompatible
steps.detail: Capability failure is reported in a UCP response with severity unrecoverable. Discovery and version failures, in contrast, are transport errors (400, 422, 424).

steps.label: Fall back to continue_url
steps.detail: The platform sends the buyer to the storefront to finish on the web. The business should choose the most relevant page: cart or checkout, product, or the homepage.
